license.name: American Building Specialties
license.registry: Arkansas Contractors Licensing Board contractor search (aclb2.arkansas.gov/clbsearch.php), linked from the board's 'Find A Licensed Contractor' page
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. The board's own lookup page links to http://aclb2.arkansas.gov/clbsearch.php, which did not load from here: HTTP 503 'upstream connect error ... connection timeout' over http, and a connection reset over https. A third-party page mentions a nightly CSV roster from the board, but no contractor roster link appears on labor.arkansas.gov/resources/rosters/ or on the find-a-contractor page. License status is unknown and no license number was found. Two web searches turned up no license record for this name, which does not prove there isn't one. Context: the company's blog (americanbuildingspecialties.blogspot.com) describes it as a supplier of commercial building products, including hollow metal doors and frames, hardware, toilet partitions and accessories, lockers and signage. It lists no city, phone or license number and does not say the company installs. A 2000 Talk Business profile (https://talkbusiness.net/2000/08/american-building-specialties/, per search snippet only, not opened) places it in North Little Rock with a Springdale branch, as a commercial hardware distributor. Arkansas requires a state commercial license only at or above the threshold ($50,000 per the board's law, as summarized in search results). Little Rock contractor cards are issued by the city when permits are pulled, and no public online registry for them was found. Next step: check the ACLB search by hand when it is back up, or call the board (501-372-4661, per search result snippet).
